paper_title: Federated Learning-Enabled Hybrid Language Models for   Communication-Efficient Token Transmission
caption: Token Resolution Breakdown for FedHLM: Local, P2P, and LLM Token Distribution.
model_annotation: The pie chart titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)" illustrates the breakdown of token routing in a Federated Learning-Enabled Hybrid Language Model (FedHLM), showing how tokens are distributed across three categories: LOCAL, EDGE_P2P, and LLM. The chart is divided into three segments, with the largest portion, colored green, representing 94.5% of the tokens routed locally. A smaller red segment accounts for 3.9% of tokens routed through the LLM (Large Language Model), and the smallest blue segment, at 1.6%, corresponds to tokens routed via EDGE_P2P (Edge Peer-to-Peer). The percentages are labeled directly within or adjacent to each slice, and the chart visually emphasizes the dominance of local token processing, with the two smaller segments grouped together on the left side of the chart. The legend or labels are positioned outside the pie, with each category clearly identified by color and text.
